items.lede: Nintendo reports higher profit but substantially lower Switch 2 sales after it increased console prices.
items.title: Switch 2 sales fell by almost 40 percent after Nintendo increased prices

items.lede: Nintendo's Switch 2 sales decreased by 41% compared to the same time frame last year due to an increase in the console's price. Investors are pressuring Nintendo to release more big games to attract more Switch 2 buyers.
items.title: Nintendo Switch 2 sales dropped by 41% from last year due to console's price increase

items.lede: Nintendo president Shuntaro Furukawa said during the company's latest earnings call that it's "not considering additional changes" to the Switch 2's price, Reuters reports.
